name: Night Work ~Yachou no I-ta-zu-ra~
original_name: ナイトワーク ～夜蝶のイ・タ・ズ・ラ～
source:
Main character becomes a host in a night club after falling victim to restructuring of the company. The night club is having difficulties and may shut down in two months time, so they don't mind recruiting a newcomer without experience.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角因公司裁员而失业后，成为了一家夜总会的男公关。夜总会经营困难，可能在两个月内倒闭，所以他们不介意招募一个没有经验的新人。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
